title: Crafty Car Adapter
description:
Power up your Crafty Vaporizer on the go with the Crafty Car Adapter! Designed for convenience, this 12-volt car charger ensures your device stays powered wherever you travel. Compatible with Storz & Bickel vaporizers, this high-quality power adapter plugs directly into your car’s lighter socket, delivering a reliable charge through its ilmicro-USB plug.

Whether you need a replacement adapter or a backup, this essential accessory keeps your sessions uninterrupted. Stay charged and ready with the Crafty Car Adapter—the perfect travel companion for any vaporizer enthusiast. Order now for a seamless charging experience!
